propositions: Bare `except Exception` in `_assemble_context_uncached` silently swallows `list_tickets` and per-child `show_ticket` failures, leaving `children` empty without recording incompleteness.
Empty `children` list causes `PlanContext.has_children` to return `False`, which makes container-scoped DET checks like `p5_task_dag` return trivial `pass` instead of signaling incomplete hierarchy.

A ticket whose hierarchy failed to load can reach an unqualified clean PASS verdict, violating parent epic AC #4 requirement that incompletely-loaded hierarchy must produce INDETERMINATE or reportable failure.

Five `finalize_verdict` call sites across `workflow_ops.py` and `gate_dispatch.py` must all thread a new `hierarchy_incomplete` flag through the `coverage` dict parameter, since only some have access to the real `PlanContext` object.

The YAML workflow `plan-review.yaml` must be updated to pass `hierarchy_incomplete` and `hierarchy_incomplete_detail` from precheck outputs to all four `plan_review_coach` invocations, or the coach-path threading defaults to `False` and defeats the fix.

`drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop` must also emit INDETERMINATE when `hierarchy_incomplete` is set, so dropped BLOCKs do not revert verdicts to PASS in contradiction/comment-trail reconciliation.
